content: Amɨn kɨnda Piŋkop do ya yaŋ iyɨgɨt

content.text: Yawe, nak but dasi nandaŋek ya yaŋ gayɨsat.
Piŋkop toptopmɨ da dabɨlon kap yaŋek mango yaŋ aŋkɨsisat.
Bɨsapmɨ bɨsapmɨ but dasi galak taŋ namɨŋek kɨlano tagɨsi asal, ae mango gat gengo gat da yo morap yapmaŋ mudaŋek uŋun da wukwisi amal.
Yaŋdo, nak Telagɨ Yut Madepgokon gawak gamɨŋek mango yaŋ aŋkɨsikeŋ.
Gak do bɨsit asat bɨsapmon nandaŋ namɨsal.
Aŋek tapmɨm namɨŋek butno aŋteban asal.
Yawe, mɨktɨmon kɨla amɨn madep morap da gengo kɨlɨ nandayɨŋ, do uŋun da mango yaŋ aŋkɨsini dosi nandɨsat.
Tɨlɨmni uŋun madepsi, do uŋun da Yawe dakon wasokni do nandaŋek kap yoni dosi nandɨsat.
Yawe uŋun wukwisi egek amɨn iyɨ do nandaba paŋ amɨn uŋun nandaŋ yomɨŋek kɨlani asak.
Mani iyɨ do nandaba wɨgɨsak amɨn uŋun yum dabɨl dagɨn pɨndakdak.
Jɨgɨ mibɨlɨ mibɨlɨ altaŋ naba kɨlano aŋaki dɨma kɨmokdot.
Uwalno da nak do japmɨ nandaŋ, mani gak tapmɨmgo madep, do si pabɨŋ yopmaŋek nak aŋpulugosol.
Yawe da nak niaŋsi egɨpbeŋ ae pi ni baŋ abeŋ do nandagɨt uŋun kɨlano aŋakwan aŋ mudokeŋ.
Mudok mudogɨ mɨni nak do but dasi galak taŋ namɨsal.
Gak da nak wasagɨl, do dɨma ɨŋtaŋ nabi.
